It goes on smoothly and, best of all, it wears invisibly. No white cast, no weird residue, so you can layer other products right over it or even wear it outside the house without a second thought. A small price to pay for everything else this mask delivers. I'll definitel

I was really excited to try this after my esthetician recommended a mandelic acid mask following my facial.. A few weeks in, I'm still getting to know it — and my biggest takeaway is that the 1–3 hour to overnight suggestion is probably not where you want to start if it's a newer ingredient for you. I made the mistake of leaving it on for 3 hours and my face was noticeably red and irritated afterward. Totally my fault for jumping in too fast, but I wish the instructions emphasized building up tolerance more explicitly. I've since dialed way back and am doing shorter sessions to let my skin adjust, which seems to be working much better. The results when I don't overdo it do seem genuinely promising — I can see why it gets good reviews. I just think this one rewards patience. If you're new to mandelic acid, treat this like you're introducing any active and work your way up slowly. I'm looking forward to updating this review once I've had more time with it, because I think there's a lot of potential here.
